study_title: Technical Performance Margin Monitoring on NASA Li-ion Battery Aging Data
design: Secondary prognostics analysis of laboratory battery aging time series
source_name: NASA Ames PCoE Li-ion Battery Aging Dataset (B0005, B0006, B0007, B0018)
license_note: Primary NASA dataset is public. The convenience CSV is a transparent extraction of NASA MATLAB files; cite NASA/Saha & Goebel and the conversion source.
claim_boundary: This is a transparent prognostics baseline, not a validated production health-management model. The processed CSV is a convenience derivative of the NASA source. B0007 demonstrates that a projected crossing inside the observed horizon need not actually occur; projection is not observation.
